اهتدين (form VIII)
# اِهْتَدَيْنَ (ihtadayna) /ih.ta.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# اُهْتُدِينَ (uhtudīna) /uh.tu.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# اِهْتَدِينَ (ihtadīna) /ih.ta.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
